body.objective: Characterize Weyl gravity FULLY in the reverse-physics sense: for each layer of the theory, which minimal physical assumptions is the layer EQUIVALENT to, with independence witnesses and an honest ledger. Four layers. (1) THE ACTION is done: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1 shows S = alpha int sqrt(-g) C^2 is equivalent to five assumptions rather than implied by six, with the derivative order DERIVED from D - 2k = 0 rather than assumed, and RP-PARITY independent on actions but redundant on field equations. (2) THE FIELD EQUATIONS were recorded as never computed by this stream; that was true of the stream and false of the repository, and the layer is now partly discharged (see current_gate). (3) THE GAUGE STRUCTURE (RP-DIFF, the BRST/BV complex) is UNTOUCHED and is the largest genuine hole: RP-DIFF is what makes 'the space of curvature scalars' the right space at all, so it never appears as a row in any matrix and has no independence witness. (4) THE SPECTRUM is partial: weyl-ghost-forced.md proves the uniqueness theorem and the ghost theorem are the same theorem, both following from D - 2k = 0; the DYNAMICAL consequence of the ghost is not characterized, and GHOST_MODEL_OBSTRUCTION showed the coprime obstruction does not decide it in either direction. Underneath all four sits the GEOMETRY column, which PHYSICS-VS-MATH.md itself calls 'the bulk of the intellectual content', imported and unverified.

body.current_gate: PHASE 3 OPENED AND ITS CENTRAL GAP CLOSED — RP-DIFF HAS AN INDEPENDENCE WITNESS (REVERSE_PHYSICS_DIFF_INDEPENDENCE_V1, reverse_physics/reports/diff-independence.md). The ledger had recorded RP-DIFF as having NO witness at all and called it the largest genuine hole; that was true of the CARRIER, not the assumption, and it is the same shape as RP-REVERSIBLE in section 4.2 — unwitnessable on a carrier where the assumption cannot fail, resolved by moving to one where it can. The classification's carrier is quadratic curvature scalars, diff-invariant BY CONSTRUCTION. Enlarging to local metric densities at derivative order zero (dropping the requirement that indices contract into scalars), the lowest weight-zero degree sqrt(-g) h^ab h^cd is 55-dimensional and entirely Weyl invariant while its diffeomorphism-invariant subspace is EXACTLY ZERO — the kernel of the sixteen GL(4) generators, exact rank over Q by two independent routines that agree, with a CONTROL SPACE (h^ab g_cd) whose known one-dimensional invariant the same machinery finds, so the zero is not a broken computation. Every one of the 55 is a witness; sqrt(-g) (g^00)^2 is the explicit one and is moved by 7 of 16 generators. THE CONSEQUENCE IS THE POINT: the witness sits at DERIVATIVE ORDER ZERO, while section 4.3's derived order says k = D/2 = 2. That derivation runs through G3, the conformal weight of the WEYL TENSOR, which is a curvature scalar and hence already diff-covariant. So THE DERIVED DERIVATIVE ORDER REQUIRES RP-DIFF — the stream's best result was silently using the one assumption the ledger had marked as carrying no weight. Section 4.3 stands; its input is now named. This is recorded as section 4.7, the seventh time the separation changed the answer, and the first where the thing that changed was an assumption believed untestable in principle. CONDITIONAL, STATED NOT HIDDEN: this is independence GIVEN RP-METRIC, because the Stuckelberg escape (promote coordinates to fields and any non-covariant theory covariantises) is BLOCKED by the field content rather than refuted; the ledger row traces to both assumptions. SCOPE: derivative order zero and the LOWEST weight-zero degree (2,0) only; degrees (3,1), (4,2), ... are also weight zero and are not classified. NOT QUANTUM: this repository's quantum chain separately computes that pure-Diff anomaly cohomology vanishes in D = 4 (AFN0_DIFF_MIXED_MINIMAL_BV_H14: pure_Diff even 0 odd 0, mixed_independent 0, with the degree-three symmetric invariant space of the metric structure algebra zero and degrees two and four retained as nonzero controls); that is a DIFFERENT question at a DIFFERENT level, it is NOT used as evidence here and this is not evidence for it. SURVEY FINDING WORTH KEEPING: H04_GAUGE_FIXED_BV_RESULT gives the counterterm slot as even {CT_C2, CT_E4} dim 2, odd {CT_C_DUAL_C} dim 1, with CT_BOX_R exact — which is EXACTLY the reverse-physics action classification, computed by a completely different route (BRST cohomology in a local jet algebra with ghosts, antifields and gauge fixing, versus exact rational linear algebra on a hand-built coordinate space). Neither was set up to check the other. HAZARD: box R appears in three unrelated roles — CT_BOX_R and ANOM_OMEGA_BOX_R are EXACT (trivial in cohomology, removable by a local counterterm, the familiar scheme-dependence of the box-R trace-anomaly term) while N2's box R is a CLASSICAL trace of field equations whose NON-vanishing carries the trace law. Same symbol, three objects. Also BRST ghosts are not the Ostrogradsky ghost. NEXT: the gauge layer's remaining question is whether the enlarged-carrier result extends past the lowest degree, and whether RP-DIFF and RP-METRIC should be merged into a single ledger row given the Stuckelberg entanglement. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: PHASE 1 COMPLETE — THE GEOMETRY COLUMN IS CLOSED, and the field-equation layer is now characterized by VARIATION rather than by definition. N2 is discharged (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_TRACE_LAW_V1, reverse_physics/reports/weyl-trace-law.md) and is sharper than the ledger stated it: for S = int sqrt(-g)(a Riem^2 + b Ric^2 + c R^2) the trace of the metric variation is g^{mn} E_mn = 2 (a + b + 3c) box R, where a + b + 3c = 0 is EXACTLY the single linear equation the action classification proves cuts out the Weyl-invariant subspace. So the multiple is 2 (nonzero) and the anomaly FACTORISES into the Weyl-invariance functional times box R, making the kernel of the trace map exactly span{C^2, E4} — which is the RP-WEYL <==> RP-TRACELESS equivalence with its reverse direction supplied. NOTE FOR THE LEDGER'S SHAPE: N2 and G5 need the SAME witness (box R != 0), so a ledger that lost G5 would silently lose N2. The variational link delta int sqrt(-g) C^2 = 4 int sqrt(-g) B_mn delta g^mn is NO LONGER CITED: E^{(C^2)}_mn = 4 B_mn is computed here against the repository's own independently calculated Bach tensor on a metric that is neither Einstein nor conformally flat, and the factor 4 is COMPUTED, agreeing with the Nariai value. The two quadratic field-equation tensors remain IMPORTED textbook forms, validated three independent ways (divergence-freedom — which is what FIXES the Riemann coupling sign, with the opposite sign failing as a control; the Bach cross-check; and the trace law holding at metrics of different symmetry). The Lanczos step E^{(Riem^2)} = 4 E^{(Ric^2)} - E^{(R^2)} is CITED (same content as G4/N3) and the trace law is additionally checked on the {Ric^2, R^2} subspace where no Lanczos input is needed. 3 metrics, 19 checks, 4/4 negative controls rejected; Schwarzschild is included precisely because it WITNESSES NOTHING (Ricci-flat and Einstein, so box R = 0 and B = 0 and every check passes vacuously) and carries a witnesses_nothing flag. NEXT: Phase 3, the gauge layer (RP-DIFF), which is the largest genuine hole; either an independence witness or an exact obstruction showing the question is not well posed there. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: GEOMETRY COLUMN NOW CLOSED EXCEPT N2 (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_DUAL_DISCHARGE_V1, reverse_physics/reports/weyl-dual-discharge.md). The G6/G8 block is lifted. The fix was NOT to repair the epsilon by trial: hodge.py turned out to fix star_square_sign, the eigenvalues and the projectors but NOT the epsilon index placement on a rank-four tensor, which is where the error lived. The working placement is eps_{abcd} = sqrt(|det g|)[abcd] all-lower, (*T)_{abcd} = (1/2) eps_{ab}^{ef} T_{efcd}, all four indices raised before contraction; the previous attempt double-raised two slots. Reproducing star_square_sign is a CHECKED ROW, not an assumption. FINDING: G8 is TWO statements, not one. Euclidean W_pm^2 = (C^2 +- P)/2 with real projectors; Lorentzian W_pm^2 = (C^2 -+ i P)/2 with the complex projectors hodge.py specifies, and the textbook Euclidean form is CHECKED FALSE in Lorentzian signature rather than merely omitted. G6's computable clause (Riem.*Riem = C.*C) is discharged; its spanning clause is a dimension count and is cited. TRAP RECORDED: the G6 check is VACUOUS on a Ricci-flat metric, where Riem = C identically, so Lorentzian Taub-NUT cannot support it however cleanly it passes; it is carried by non-Einstein metrics and every row reports ricci_is_nonzero. 4 metric/signature rows, 18 checks, 3/3 negative controls rejected. G4, G7 and N3 are CITED to existing repository certificates, each carrying its source's own boundary — G4 to EULER_TRANSGRESSION_CERTIFICATE for the VARIATIONAL content only (not an index theorem), G7 to the Chern-Weil transgression in symbolic/verify_conformal_dynamical_topological.py whose docstring states that global triviality of the Pontryagin class is explicitly not claimed, and N3 to the same delta_E4_minus_dTheta check as G4 since it is the same content. N2 IS THE ONE ENTRY STILL GENUINELY OPEN and is the next thing to do: it is the bridge between the action ledger and the field-equation ledger and needs the metric VARIATION rather than pointwise curvature algebra. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: GEOMETRY COLUMN PARTIALLY DISCHARGED, and the remainder is blocked in a named place. DISCHARGED (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_GEOMETRY_DISCHARGE_V1, 21 exact checks): G1 (C^2 = Riem^2 - 2Ric^2 + R^2/3), G2 (the conformal law for R), G3 (the Weyl tensor's conformal weight, which the derived derivative order rests on), G5 (the non-degeneracy witness, previously NAMED and not formalised and ranked by the ledger as the sharpest attack on the programme — matter-dominated FRW gives R = 4/(3t^2) and box R = -8/(3t^4)), and N1 (nabla^a B_ab = 0, computed for the actual Bach tensor). BLOCKED: G6 (P = C.Cdual spans the parity-odd invariants) and G8 (W_pm^2 = (C^2 pm P)/2). A first attempt got the split ALGEBRA exactly right on Lorentzian Taub-NUT — W_+^2 - W_-^2 = P and W_+^2 + W_-^2 = (C^2 + Cdual^2)/2 both hold exactly at an exact algebraic point — but Cdual^2 != -C^2, i.e. the epsilon index placement/normalization is wrong. The fix is to express the dual in local_bv/hodge.py's conventions, NOT to repair the epsilon by trial. UNWIRED: G4 and G7 are global (topological) and unreachable pointwise, but the transgression work already exists and should be cited. NOT STARTED: the gauge layer. COMPARISON LAYOUT ADDED (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_VS_EINSTEIN_LEDGER_V1, reverse_physics/reports/OPENS-AND-CHALLENGES.md): the three-column ledger states what the theory IS and cannot state what it DOES relative to Einstein gravity, so the layout gains a DIRECTION (OPENS/CHALLENGES/SHARED) and a LEVEL (L0 action through L4 quantum). The level axis is forced by two results this repository already held: Ric = Lambda g implies B_mn = 0 at L2, and REDUCED_FLAT_EINSTEIN_SYMPLECTIC_EMBEDDING_REFUTED at L3, so 'Einstein gravity is contained in Weyl gravity' is true at L2 and false at L3. The organising claim is a single forced assumption swap (RP-2ND-ORDER for RP-WEYL, jointly unsatisfiable in D=4 because D-2k=0 with derivative order 2k), which makes OPENS and CHALLENGES two halves of one trade rather than a pros-and-cons list; the sharpest pair is one theorem read twice, since the equation that DERIVES the derivative order is the equation that FORCES the ghost. 18 rows, 4 of them OPEN, with rails that forbid citing into the MATHEMATICS column, require a counterfactual for every PHYSICS row, and require level flips and trade edges to be mutual. No row is new physics.
body.stop_condition: EITHER every entry of the GEOMETRY column is discharged or explicitly cited to an existing certificate, the field-equation layer is characterized by variation rather than definition, and the gauge layer has at least one independence witness for RP-DIFF — at which point 'fully characterized' is a defensible claim for three of four layers with the fourth ledgered; OR a layer returns an exact obstruction showing the reverse-physics question is not well posed there, which is itself the deliverable and must be recorded with the same rails.
body.forbid: claiming any geometric fact is PROVED when it is DISCHARGED — the discharge verifies exactly at specific metrics, which is strictly stronger than an unverified import and strictly weaker than a theorem for all metrics, and the certificate must keep saying so in those words; asserting G8's W_pm^2 = (C^2 pm P)/2 without its signature qualification, since the Lorentzian Hodge star squares to -1 on two-forms (local_bv/hodge.py records eigenvalues pm i) so W_pm are complex conjugates there and the decomposition as stated is EUCLIDEAN; reinventing any convention this repository already maintains — three attempts in this stream (Riemann tensor, Bach tensor, action variation) each concluded 'we do not have this' about the STREAM while the REPOSITORY had it, and the fourth (the Hodge dual) produced a wrong normalization; promoting a discharge on a Ricci-flat metric to a statement about the R^2 or Ric^2 coefficients, which VANISH there and cannot be seen; using any certificate in this stream as evidence inside the Weyl classical or quantum chains, or vice versa; treating the coprime/ghost toy-model results as statements about Weyl gravity, which they explicitly are not.
